item.tib: sku gsum dgongs pa 'dus pa'i rgyud phyag mu tig phreng ba
item.coloph: zhal shes khyer bde mu tig phreng ba 'di/ mos slob dang po seng has rkyen bskul ngor/ kho bo sras zol rig sngags 'dzin des bris/ dge bas mkha' khyab rig 'dzin sar 'god shog/

item.tib: sku gsum dgongs pa 'dus pa yi brgyud phyag mu tig phreng ba
item.coloph: de skad brgyud (rgud) phyag mu tig 'phreng ba 'di/ mos slob dang po seng has rgyan (rkyen) bskul ngor/ kho bo sras zol rigs sngags 'dzin des bris/ dge bas mkha' khyab rig 'dzin sar 'god shog/
